keyFindings.description: A refused relaunch attempt is not side-effect-free, so the retry's stated invariant ('leaves the claim exactly as stale as it found it', plugin.go:29-32, table.go:113-117, daemon.go:1148-1150, api/claims.go:338-343) is false: refreshPlugin writes the 'relaunching' Warn and sets PluginRelaunchFor = deps.PluginContract, and replaceProcess interrupts the pending task (repoint.go:38), all before launch's checkLaunch (machine.go:829-832) can refuse. Observed in my round-1 throwaway (relaunchFor=24 after the refused attempt). Consequences, each bounded: a later stale registration (a pod-replacing relaunch into an old-image pod) is charged one launch failure for a relaunch that never ran (staleRegistration → relaunchAfterFailure); the still-running stale process is re-prompted with its own task as 'interrupted' when its turn ends; one false 'relaunching' line per sweep per stuck claim. Fix: check the gate first in refreshPlugin when no suspension is held (the convention relaunchAfterFailure already follows, budgets.go:47-53), so a refused attempt changes nothing; have the sweep test assert PluginRelaunchFor and the pending delivery unchanged after the refusal.

The URL branch accepts host-less shapes — `https:///x.tgz` and `http:/cache/x.tgz` parse with scheme http(s), empty Host and IsAbs true — which bun cannot fetch; same invariant as the resolved `//` thread. Require u.Host != "" on the URL branch with one named refusal.

The justification 'the same cadence the moved-address twin (StaleAddress) already gets from this same sweep' is wrong: StaleAddress is produced by the runtime's own Observe loop at Timeouts.Probe (sandbox/watch.go, tmux/observe.go), not by reconcileOrphans. Say the sweep is the one periodic pass that already reads every claim.

The doc says CheckLaunch 'answers check instead when it is non-nil, falling through to the real store otherwise'; the code is a pre-check in series (a nil from check still runs the real store's CheckLaunch). Describe it as the pre-check it is.
